verses.text: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.

segments.text: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.

verses.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

segments.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.text: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

segments.text: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.

segments.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.

verses.text: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.

segments.text: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.

verses.text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

segments.text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.text: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

segments.text: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.text: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.

segments.text: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.

verses.text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”

segments.text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”

verses.text: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

segments.text: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.text: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,

segments.text: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,

verses.text: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.

segments.text: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.

verses.text: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,

segments.text: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,

verses.text: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.

segments.text: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.

verses.text: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

segments.text: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

verses.text: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

segments.text: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

verses.text: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

segments.text: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

verses.text: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,

segments.text: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,

verses.text: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.

segments.text: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.

verses.text: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.

segments.text: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.

verses.text: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.

segments.text: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.

verses.text: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

segments.text: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

verses.text: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

segments.text: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

verses.text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

segments.text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

verses.text: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.

segments.text: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.

verses.text: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

segments.text: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

segments.text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

segments.text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

segments.text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

verses.text: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.

segments.text: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.

verses.text: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.

segments.text: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.

verses.text: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
